label: Auto
description: Recommended server preset with Efficient and Capable targets.

label: Stage router
description: Start efficient. Escalate when tool signals call for it.

label: Capability
description: A judge forecasts the capacity each request needs.

label: Custom classifier
description: Choose between role groups using your own judge policy.

label: Escalation
description: Judge completed efficient turns and failure evidence.

label: Composite
description: Classifier chooses the starting tier; stage signals adjust it.

label: Advisor
description: An advisor reviews executor work and requests corrections.

label: Random
description: Distribute requests among two to six targets.

label: Passthrough
description: Send requests to one selected model.

label: No-op
description: Return OK without calling a model.

label: Prefill router
description: Optional: requires a feature-enabled server and checkpoint.

label: Plan → execute
description: Plan with Capable, then hold execution on Efficient.

label: Verification-gated routing
description: Shadow mode serves Capable while evaluating Efficient.
